blocks.content: The agent's contract surface: ChatMessage (role/content/toolCalls/images), ToolCall, ToolSpec, ToolContext (cwd, resolvePath, scratchDir, updatePlan, onOutput), PlanEntry, ApprovalRequest, and the AgentEvent union the loop emits. The Provider interface defines the streamChat contract both backends implement, including the v2 params ({numCtx, temperature}) pass-through.

AgentEvent covers the whole turn lifecycle: turn-start (with imageCount), text-delta, thought-delta, tool-start, tool-output (live command streaming), tool-end (with optional diff), plan, turn-end, turn-error, notice (via the shared mirror), and step-start. Every renderer and the persistence layer consume these shapes — shared/timelineModel.ts mirrors this union structurally to stay import-clean on both sides.
listModels() + streamChat(opts, callbacks) — the seam that makes smoke tests backend-agnostic.
Carries cwd, resolvePath (sandbox), scratchDir, updatePlan, onOutput into every tool execution.
